title: The Open Textbook Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Textbooks with verified open-access availability and documented reuse licenses. The Open Textbook Database tracks textbooks that are genuinely open: verified open-access download links, the exact reuse license (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC and others), and what the license permits for remixing and printing. Each record documents where the verification happened and when, so stale or revoked links are caught. The Signature side adds per-chapter alignment notes mapping open chapters to standard paid-textbook chapters.
capabilities: Verify open-access download links and record verification dates
Document exact reuse licenses and what each permits
Map open chapters to equivalent paid-textbook chapters
Track license versions and attribution requirements
List print and remixed versions derived from each open textbook
